newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Coles 2nd qtr sales rise 5.2 percent.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Coles 2nd qtr sales rise 5.2 percent.

text.p: Leading retailer Coles Myer Ltd said on Wednesday that 1996/97 second quarter sales rose 5.2 percent to A$5.50 billion.
The company said the sales in the second quarter of 1995/96 were A$5.229 billion.
It said sales in the latest six months ended January 26 this year rose 5.4 percent to A$9.945 billion from A$9.440 billion a year ago.
"The results achieved the company's plan and reflected satisfactory pre-and post-Christmas trading," the company said in a statement.

Coles said key factors in the first half result included a 12.3 percent rise in second quarter sales for the Food and Liquor Group, which includes the Coles, Bi-Lo and Liquorland operations. First half sales from this group rose 11.7 percent.
The company also said second quarter and first half sales from the General Merchandise Group, which consists of Kmart, Officeworks, and World 4 Kids, were both 2.5 percent below year-ago levels.
It said the Kmart sales trend improved in the second quarter with a decline of four percent compared with a 5.3 percent fall in the first quarter.
Non-comparable sales by Myer Grace Bros fell 1.6 percent in the second quarter and fell by 1.3 percent in the latest half.
"Sports and recreation, homewares and Miss Shop showed strong growth but general apparel remains difficult," divisional managing director Terry McCartney said.

Coles Myer chief executive Dennis Eck said the latest sales result was encouraging, particularly when compared with the current overall sales climate. "We are particularly pleased with the correction of Kmart's merchandising, Target's continued strength, Myer Sport and the Food and Liquor group performance," Eck said. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
